name: DetailCustomer
title: Blocks/Detail/DetailCustomer
summary: The profile of one customer a support agent opens from a ticket or a search, as a page body for ConsoleLayout. A `PageHeader` names the customer with a square `Avatar`, their organization as the description, and the actions Edit, More actions (an `IconButton` with a `Tooltip` opening a `DropdownMenu`: Merge customer, Export data, Delete customer) and New ticket. Below it a details column (a `Card` with a `KeyValueList`: email and phone with a `CopyButton`, local time, language, the organization `Link`, the tags as `Tag`s and customer since, then a Satisfaction `Card` with a read-only `Rating` and the survey count) sits beside `Tabs`, and stacks above them in a narrow container. Tickets is a `DataTable` of the customer's tickets (subject `Link`, `TableCellStatus`, `PriorityTag`, the next-reply `Countdown`, `TableCellTime`) with an `EmptyState` for a customer with none; Activity is a `Timeline` grouped by day; Notes is a `MessageThread` of internal notes over a `Field` with a `Textarea` and Add note. Loading draws `Skeleton`s, the table's skeleton rows and the timeline and thread placeholders; a failed load shows a danger `Alert` with Retry. The sample renders under a `ConfigProvider` with a fixed clock.

variants.name: Activity
variants.summary: The Activity tab: a `Timeline` with one group per day, newest first, each event with its marker, actor and time (ticket opened, replied, merged, rated, solved).

variants.name: Notes
variants.summary: The Notes tab: the internal notes agents left on the customer as a `MessageThread` of notes, oldest first, then the Add a note field and the Add note button.

variants.name: NoTickets
variants.summary: A customer created today: no phone and no tags, No ratings yet, the Tickets tab showing the No tickets yet empty state with New ticket, and one activity event.

variants.name: Loading
variants.summary: While the customer loads: the Customer title with skeletons for the avatar and organization, the actions disabled, skeleton values in the details, and skeleton rows in the tickets table.

variants.name: Error
variants.summary: The customer failed to load: the Customer title with no actions and a danger `Alert` with Retry in place of the details and tabs.
